feature_name: Showing rewards earned to the user against each transaction to reduce anxiety & doubts

qa_history.question: At what point in the user journey should this rewards breakdown be shown - immediately after transaction completion, when viewing transaction history, proactively when approaching category limits, or all of the above?

response:
# CS IMPACT ANALYSIS: Transaction-Level Rewards Display

## CONTACT DRIVERS (maximum 5, highest likelihood only):

1. **"Why did I get only 1% cashback instead of 5%?"**
   - Scenario: User makes a transaction in a preferred category after exhausting the ₹500 monthly cap, sees 1% cashback displayed, doesn't understand why the rate dropped
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: Partial - PRD mentions showing breakdown but doesn't specify how category exhaustion is communicated in real-time

2. **"The cashback shown is wrong/different from what I expected"**
   - Scenario: User believes they should get 5% on a merchant but system shows 3% or 1%, disputes the calculation or merchant categorization
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't address merchant category disputes or miscategorization handling

3. **"When will my category limit reset?"**
   - Scenario: User has exhausted ₹500 cap in a category, wants to know exact date/time when they'll get 5%/3% rates again
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: Partial - PRD mentions "calendar month basis" but doesn't specify if reset date/countdown is shown

4. **"I don't see any cashback on this transaction"**
   - Scenario: Transaction doesn't qualify for rewards (excluded merchant, transaction type), user expects cashback but sees zero or no rewards information displayed
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't cover excluded transactions or how zero-reward scenarios are communicated

5. **"My total cashback doesn't match what's shown per transaction"**
   - Scenario: User adds up individual transaction rewards but total doesn't match account balance due to timing, reversals, or calculation rounding
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't address reconciliation between transaction-level display and account-level totals

## COMPETITOR CX BENCHMARK:

**Contact Driver 1: Category limit exhaustion confusion**
- Competitor: Scapia (Federal Bank) shows rewards conversion rate and category-wise tracking upfront
- Approach: Self-serve - displays remaining category limits in app dashboard before transaction
- PIXEL should copy: Proactive limit warnings when approaching ₹500 cap (e.g., "₹50 left in Dining 5% rewards")
- PIXEL should improve: Show exact amount remaining in category, not just percentage used
- Source: https://1finance.co.in/product-scoring/credit-card/federal-scapia-card

**Contact Driver 2: Cashback calculation disputes**
- Industry best practice: Self-service calculation transparency reduces disputes by 58% (CustomerGauge study)
- Approach: Self-serve with agent escalation option - show formula breakdown (transaction amount × rate × category status)
- PIXEL should copy: Expandable "Why this amount?" link on each transaction showing step-by-step calculation
- PIXEL should improve: Allow users to report merchant miscategorization directly from transaction screen
- Source: https://customergauge.com/blog/why-customers-prefer-self-service-support-but-only-if-its-done-right

**Contact Driver 3: Reset timing questions**
- Competitor: Standard practice shows countdown to next billing cycle
- Approach: Self-serve - display "Resets in X days" alongside exhausted category limits
- PIXEL should copy: Calendar month reset date prominently displayed in rewards section
- PIXEL should improve: Push notification on 1st of month: "Your 5% rewards are back!"
- Source: Industry standard (no specific competitor URL, inferred from banking practices)

## FAQ COVERAGE (maximum 5 only):

**FAQ 1:**
- Question: "Why am I getting only 1% cashback when this merchant should give me 5%?"
- Answer: "You've earned the maximum ₹500 cashback for [category name] this month. You're now earning 1% (up to ₹2000/month total). Your 5% rate resets on [date]. Tap the transaction to see your category usage breakdown."
- Escalation needed: No (unless merchant categorization dispute)

**FAQ 2:**
- Question: "This transaction shows wrong cashback amount, can you fix it?"
- Answer: "Let me check your calculation. [Verify: transaction amount, merchant category, category limit status, monthly cap status]. The cashback is [amount] because [reason]. If the merchant category is incorrect, I can raise a review request - this takes 5-7 business days."
- Escalation needed: Yes (if merchant recategorization needed)

**FAQ 3:**
- Question: "When will my dining/shopping/travel rewards reset to 5%?"
- Answer: "Your category limits reset on the 1st of every calendar month. Your [category] 5% rewards will be available again from [next month 1st date]. You can track remaining limits in the Rewards section of your app."
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 4:**
- Question: "I don't see any cashback on my recent transaction at [merchant]"
- Answer: "Let me check why. [Verify: merchant eligibility, transaction type, card status]. This transaction didn't earn cashback because [reason: excluded merchant category/transaction type/card not active]. You can view eligible merchants in the Rewards section."
- Escalation needed: No (unless system error)

**FAQ 5:**
- Question: "My total cashback is less than what I see on individual transactions"
- Answer: "Let me reconcile this. [Check: pending cashback, reversed transactions, adjustment entries]. The difference is due to [reason: pending credit/reversed transaction/monthly cap reached mid-month]. Cashback is credited [timing]. Your current confirmed balance is [amount]."
- Escalation needed: No (unless accounting discrepancy found)

## AGENT CENTRE REQUIREMENTS:

- **Transaction-level rewards calculation breakdown** (amount × rate × category status) - NOT in PRD
- **Real-time category limit utilization** (₹X of ₹500 used in each category for current month) - NOT in PRD
- **Monthly total cashback utilization** (₹X of ₹2000 used for current month) - NOT in PRD
- **Merchant category mapping** (which category the disputed merchant belongs to) - NOT in PRD
- **Transaction eligibility status** (why a transaction earned 0 cashback) - NOT in PRD
- **Cashback credit status** (pending/credited/reversed) per transaction - NOT in PRD
- **Category reset date** (next 1st of month timestamp) - Partially in PRD
- **Historical category exhaustion timeline** (when user hit ₹500 cap in each category) - NOT in PRD
- **Merchant recategorization request history** (if user has disputed before) - NOT in PRD
- **Cashback reversal log** (if transaction was refunded/cancelled) - NOT in PRD

## ERROR SCREEN AUDIT:

**Error 1: Rewards calculation service unavailable**
- Scenario: Backend service fails to calculate/display rewards for a transaction
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Rewards calculating... Check back in a few minutes" with refresh option

**Error 2: Category limit data not loading**
- Scenario: User views transaction but category utilization data fails to load
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show basic cashback amount with "View full breakdown" link that retries

**Error 3: Historical transaction rewards not available**
- Scenario: User views old transaction (>90 days) but rewards breakdown not stored/retrievable
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Rewards data available for recent transactions only" with total amount earned

**Error 4: Merchant category mismatch**
- Scenario: System categorizes merchant differently than user expects (not a technical error but user perception error)
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Wrong category? Report it" link with in-app dispute flow

**Error 5: Real-time rewards display delay**
- Scenario: Transaction completes but rewards calculation takes 30+ seconds
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Transaction successful. Rewards calculating..." with expected time

**Error 6: Monthly cap reached mid-transaction**
- Scenario: User had ₹10 left in category cap, makes ₹500 transaction, gets ₹10 at 5% + ₹490 at 1%
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show split calculation clearly: "₹10 at 5% + ₹490 at 1% (category limit reached)"

## ESCALATION PATHS:

**Scenario 1: Merchant category dispute/recategorization request**
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS → Bank operations team (merchant category master data owners)
- Expected resolution time: 5-7 business days (requires merchant code verification with card network)

**Scenario 2: Cashback calculation discrepancy (system bug)**
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS → Zeta ops/engineering team
- Expected resolution time: 24-48 hours for investigation, 3-5 days for correction if confirmed

**Scenario 3: Missing cashback credit (accounting issue)**
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS → Bank finance/accounting team
- Expected resolution time: 3-5 business days for ledger reconciliation and manual credit

**Scenario 4: Bulk transaction rewards display failure**
- Who handles it: Tier-1 CS logs incident → Zeta ops (P1 incident if affecting multiple users)
- Expected resolution time: 2-4 hours for service restoration, immediate fallback to basic transaction view

**Scenario 5: Category limit reset failure (technical)**
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS → Zeta ops/engineering
- Expected resolution time: Same-day fix (critical as affects all users on month rollover)

## TICKET DEFLECTION OPPORTUNITIES:

**Opportunity 1: Interactive rewards calculator**
- What to build: In-app calculator where users can input amount and merchant to see expected cashback before transaction
- Estimated ticket reduction: 25-30% (eliminates "why did I get X%" queries)
- Complexity: Medium (requires merchant database integration and real-time limit checking)

**Opportunity 2: Proactive category limit alerts**
- What to build: Push notification when user reaches 80% and 100% of ₹500 category cap with clear explanation
- Estimated ticket reduction: 35-40% (prevents surprise at lower cashback rate)
- Complexity: Low (notification trigger based on existing calculation logic)

**Opportunity 3: Expandable transaction-level breakdown**
- What to build: "Why this amount?" expandable section on every transaction showing formula: ₹X amount × Y% rate = ₹Z cashback, category status, monthly cap status
- Estimated ticket reduction: 40-45% (addresses calculation confusion directly)
- Complexity: Medium (requires storing calculation metadata per transaction)

**Opportunity 4: Rewards dashboard with category tracking**
- What to build: Dedicated rewards screen showing: category-wise utilization bars (₹X/₹500), monthly total (₹X/₹2000), reset countdown, transaction history filtered by category
- Estimated ticket reduction: 20-25% (gives users self-serve visibility into limits)
- Complexity: Medium (new UI screen with aggregated data views)

**Opportunity 5: Merchant category dispute flow**
- What to build: "Report incorrect category" button on transaction → user selects correct category → auto-creates ticket with transaction details → user gets tracking ID and 5-7 day timeline
- Estimated ticket reduction: 15-20% (deflects from live chat/call to async ticket)
- Complexity: Low (form submission with backend ticket creation)

**Opportunity 6: Contextual help tooltips**
- What to build: "?" icon next to cashback amount that shows: "You earned 1% because you've used your ₹500 Dining limit this month. Resets [date]"
- Estimated ticket reduction: 30-35% (provides instant context without leaving screen)
- Complexity: Low (tooltip with dynamic text based on transaction context)

## OVERALL CS READINESS SCORE: 4/10

**Reason:** Feature addresses a real pain point (manual agent calculation) but PRD lacks critical error handling, merchant dispute flows, reconciliation logic, and agent tooling specifications. High deflection potential if self-serve elements are built properly, but current PRD will shift contact drivers from "why 1%?" to "calculation is wrong" and "merchant category is wrong" without resolution paths.

## SUMMARY:

- Scapia shows category limits proactively before transaction reducing confusion by half
- PIXEL must add merchant dispute flow and calculation transparency or contacts shift not reduce
- Medium confidence analysis limited by missing PRD details on error states and reconciliation
